defect: single-clock 1R1W array with no defined behaviour when the read address equals the write address in the same cycle
rationale: Port A writes mem and port B reads mem on the same clock with nothing handling a same-address collision; simulation returns the old word but a synthesized RAM macro may return the new word, unknown or either, so the read behaviour depends on the implementation.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Merged the two clocks into one, removed the config, reset and assertion plumbing and the memory-load include.

labels.note: A simultaneous read and write to the same address depends on the memory implementation.
